It also reached partway toward 8 by probing the environment (Python deps, offline start.sh, curl access), verifying hashes empirically rather than assuming, and concretely checking anti-cheat rules #2 and #3. But the trajectory shows no articulated reconciliation of the spec against the real contract, no explicit enumeration of the 19 gate categories, and no confirmation of the canary-strip detail — so it falls short of the deliberate, referenced reconnaissance of the 8 anchor, landing at 6.
